cards.name: hq
cards.desc: An Elixir/OTP service that coordinates teams of Claude Code agents working in parallel, and lets them message each other mid-task.
points: Messages queue while an agent is busy and survive restarts.
A separate git worktree for every task prevents conflicts between parallel agents.
The engineer can talk to any sub-agent directly.

cards.name: NoteWorks
cards.desc: A native iPad note-taking app in SwiftUI, with course spaces, a student community and AI study tools on a Supabase backend.
points: PencilKit canvas whose Apple Pencil drawing works alongside zoom and pan gestures.
Per-page ink persistence, with text, image and shape overlays on each page.
Deno edge functions serve notes, posts, comments and uploads; Gemini calls that organise notes and find gaps between them run server-side.
Apple, Google and email sign-in, plus GitHub Actions CI that checks migrations apply and TypeScript types generate.

cards.name: Ring or Ping
cards.desc: An iOS alarm that alerts your whole friend group if you snooze or stop it without getting out of bed.
points: iOS app written in Swift with personalised alarms.
Django REST framework backend deployed on Amazon EC2.

cards.name: Gnostic
cards.desc: A Chrome extension that pulls your Notion notes and turns them into flashcards.
points: Winner of Most Innovative Project at Ignition Hacks 2023.
Fetches notes through the Notion API and generates flashcards with OpenAI.
